subject: Seat true-up and HubSpot migration plan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Seat true-up and HubSpot migration plan

Team —

We need to reconcile Outreach and Salesloft seats ahead of our HubSpot migration and confirm procurement timing so Finance can cut the PO before Nov 1. Quick context: we committed to consolidate engagement tooling into HubSpot Sales last quarter. Legal wants a clean SOW and line-item seat counts to match the PO.

Asks:
- Ben: can you attach the Q3 license export and call out active seats vs reserved? (I think we have ~220 active Outreach seats but only 180 reserved)
- Lauren: what's the estimated ramp for SDRs + AEs for next Q (hiring plan) so we can model true-up vs subscription start dates?
- Marissa: lead the migration coordination with the vendor — can you confirm whether HubSpot will accept a phased onboarding (reps first, then managers) and any professional services estimates?

I attached the draft migration SOW we got from HubSpot (v2) — please review gaps and put redline comments in the doc by EOD Wednesday. If we can get counts locked this week, Finance can finalize the PO.

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seat true-up and HubSpot migration plan

Priyom —
Attached: license_usage_report_Q3.csv (pulled from Outreach admin console). Quick notes:
- Active users last 30d: 218
- Seats purchased: 180 (we have ~38 unlicensed active users currently)
- Pending hires to onboard (internal list): 12 SDRs starting 11/15, 6 AEs start dates TBD but planned for Dec.

Recommend we purchase an initial 210 seats to cover immediate needs and add a 30-seat buffer in a 60-day addendum to avoid repeated true-ups. That keeps the PO smaller but gives runway for hires.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
(attachment: license_usage_report_Q3.csv)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sam Teller <sam.teller@hubspot.com>, Priya Verma <p.verma@salesops.consult>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Seat counts + SOW — HubSpot migration (request for phased SOW and PS estimate)

Sam / Priya —

Forwarding our internal counts and the draft SOW. High level ask: can HubSpot provide a phased SOW that includes:
- Phase 1: Data migration & enablement for 210 user seats (reps + ops), target completion by 2026-11-30
- Phase 2: Manager dashboards and advanced workflows for remaining seats (if and when we ramp)
- A fixed-price itemized PS line for migration, and an optional add-on for additional data mapping beyond standard fields.

We prefer a PO with a clear seat line item and a 60-day addendum to allow simple seat adjustments without redoing whole contract. Also, do you accept Net 45 on first invoice or do we need Net 30?

Thanks —
Priyom

Date: 2026-10-21T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Seat counts + SOW — HubSpot migration (request for phased SOW and PS estimate)

Hi Priyom / team —

Thanks for the details and the CSV, that helps. We can do the phased SOW approach. Key points from our side:
- We can scope Phase 1 for 210 seats with a fixed migration fee of $28,000 (includes 1:1 data mapping for standard CRM fields, bulk contact sync, and 2 days on-site equivalent remote training).
- Phase 2 itemized work will be quoted after Phase 1 discovery; estimate ballpark $12k-$18k depending on workflow complexity.
- Contracting: HubSpot legal prefers Net 30 but we can accept Net 45 with an account exec approval for enterprise PO flows; please add that request to the PO submission.
- We will provide a contract with an optional 60-day true-up clause for seat add-ons (amendment pricing pre-defined in the contract).

I'll attach v2 of the SOW with the fixed PS lines and a sample amendment. Can you confirm you want HubSpot to run the initial data validation (we'll need CSVs and sample records)?

Best —
Sam Teller
Enterprise Sales | HubSpot
(attachment: HubSpot_Migration_SOW_v2.pdf)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sam Teller <sam.teller@hubspot.com>
Date: 2026-10-23T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seat counts + SOW — HubSpot migration (next steps & legal)

Thanks Sam — that looks reasonable. Legal has one ask: they want the SOW redlines included in a single Word document and a clause clarifying data retention for event/engagement logs (48 months default is fine but need IL/CCPA compliance language). I've uploaded our redline doc: HubSpot_Contract_Redlines_20261022.docx and commented in the GDoc link.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa: confirm whether HubSpot does the initial validation (Sam: please confirm scope + sample CSV spec)
- Ben: update the license count to 210 in the PO draft and add the 30-seat optional amendment line item
- Priyom: once legal confirms the Net 45 exception, Finance will approve PO issuance with Nov 1 start date.

I'll loop in Legal directly after we get the final SOW.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Enablement | Redwood Inference
(attachment: HubSpot_Contract_Redlines_20261022.docx)
